asr_text: The strange thing about the next screen may be that it is not a screen at all. The smartphone is still part of the picture, but digital tasks are beginning to spread across the places where people already speak, listen, drive, and live. Google says Gemini Intelligence will begin on selected Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel phones, then reach watches, cars, glasses, and laptops later in 2026. Google has also announced Agent Mode, an experimental desktop feature for AI Ultra subscribers in the United States. It is designed to manage complex tasks with little oversight.
